name: main
notes: state machine on DS:0086: FFh config, 1 title, 2 protection check, 3 top scores, 4 menus, 5 race (legs x players, results math), 6 = between legs

name: exit_to_dos
notes: snd_shutdown, mem_free_all, gfx 1736(1), restore BIOS mode DS:E862, 16fc:000b, kbd_restore, exit(0)

name: harderr_handler
notes: INT 24h handler installed with _harderr: code 0 -> message 23h 'Write Protect?', 2 -> 24h 'Drive Not Ready?', then _hardresume(1 = retry); other codes -> fatal_exit(5)

name: fatal_exit
notes: shutdown + text message: 1 RAM (DS:0106+0137), 2 file open (015B), 3 .HI write (0189), 5 hardware (01BB), else 01E9; exit(code)

name: config_load
notes: reads TD3.CFG or asks on the text screen (video 1-4, sound 1-5, save Y/N), sets DS:E338 = DS:00EA[video], DS:0096, DS:0098; sets the graphics mode, allocates 2 pages (8 -> fatal 1), DS:90CC/90CE = page segments

name: cfg_show_video_choice
notes: text-mode digit at col 20h row 8

name: cfg_show_sound_choice
notes: text-mode digit at col 20h row 11h

name: cfg_show_yes_no
notes: text-mode 'N' (DS:0442) / 'Y' (DS:0444) at col 2Ch row 15h

name: pal_load
notes: 112 colours (336 bytes) -> DS:0B6A palette buffer at colour 16 + DS:90F0; applied at once in VGA unless game_state == 5

name: pal_load_32
notes: 32 colours (96 bytes) -> palette buffer at colour 48 + DS:90F0 (car SIC.BIN)

name: file_load_near
notes: archive_open, read whole entry (size-1 when archived, file size otherwise) to a DS buffer

name: file_load_far
notes: same as file_load_near into a far buffer; sets DS:E86A = bytes read, DS:E86C = 0

name: random
notes: seed DS:00D2 (u32) = seed*41C64E6Dh + 3039h; returns (seed >> 16) & 7FFFh (not the MSC rand constants)

name: key_poll
notes: takes DS:915B (or joystick keys), handles the hotkeys Esc/Ctrl-P/Q/S/E/J/K/A/D, stores the result in *key and DS:E08C; any key -> DS:008C = 1 (hud: key_read, platform: get_key)

name: mem_alloc_all
notes: allocates the 13 far buffers + a 300h-paragraph DOS block; any failure -> fatal_exit(1) (the 'RAM check')

name: mem_free_all
notes: frees the buffers of mem_alloc_all and the DOS block

name: nop_1518
notes: empty

name: nop_151a
notes: empty

name: archive_open
notes: looks the name (without drive) up in the DS:049E directory; builds A:DATAx.DAT / car .DAT / scene .DAT, opens it (prompting for the disk until it opens), seeks to the entry, DS:E86A:E86C = size; returns handle or 0 if not archived

name: name_hash_h1
notes: h = h*mul + c over the characters from last to first (signed chars)

name: name_hash_h2
notes: sum c[i]*i over all characters except the last

name: name_hash
notes: (h1(s,101h) << 16) | h2(s), the archive directory key (FORMATS.md)

name: message_box
notes: message DS:16DA[id] in a grey box at y 71h-85h; per-id wait/prompt behaviour (Y/N, drive letter, steering 1-9, joystick calibration...)

name: joystick_keys
notes: if DS:0092: read joystick, button -> 0Dh, else direction -> DS:00AA[DS:947B & 0Fh] (arrow codes)

name: joystick_direction
notes: widens the calibration min/max (DS:00BC/00C0, 00C6/00CA) and adds direction bits to DS:947B: 8 right, 4 left, 2 down, 1 up

name: player_rec_load
notes: copies 25 bytes of player DS:09C5 (1-based) from DS:E7F4 + 1Bh*(p-1) to DS:09C6

name: player_rec_save
notes: copies DS:09C6 (25 bytes) back to the player's record

name: title_sequence
notes: Accolade logo + light sweep, TITLE1/2 (mirrored), TITLEANI/LET/L2/CAR animation, credits pictures and the credits text; any key aborts; returns 0

name: top_score_enter
notes: name entry (14 chars), 'TJL' cheat flag DS:9485, inserts DS:09DA / DS:0AFE / name into the top-7 table, hi_write

name: top_scores_screen
notes: TOPSCORA/B/C.LZ + TOPCOLR.BIN; title, scene name, 7 scores + car names + hi_names; your score if 1 player; waits for a key; clears DS:09DA

name: print_score
notes: 8-digit decimal without leading zeros (digits DS:EA7A.. -> DS:EA84 + 80h) printed with print_text

name: main_menu
notes: SELECT.LZ screen with a rotating 3D car (frame_update/frame_draw with DS:09C4 = 1); arrows move DS:E5AC (0 = race, 1 options, 2 car, 3 course, 4 play disk), Enter returns it

name: gfx_frame
type: far void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: rectangle outline (name from hud.md)

name: menu_box_draw
type: far void(int item int colour int colour2)
notes: frame around menu item (0 = big top box, 1-4 = bottom boxes 80 px apart); colour2 == 0 adds a colour-1 shadow

name: credits_text
notes: prints each AAh-ended string at (y 3, col 1) for 27h x 2 BIOS ticks until a 00 00 pair; key aborts

name: print_records
notes: prints records {col,row,text} ended by 80h (next record) or AAh (end); returns the offset after AAh

name: print_text
notes: prints characters until a byte >= 80h at the current text position; returns offset after it

name: print_record
notes: one {col,row,text} record; returns offset after its terminator

name: print_chars
notes: prints n characters

name: wait_key
notes: n-1 x (delay 2 BIOS ticks, random, key_poll); returns the key (low byte) or n on timeout; n = 0 waits forever

name: screen_present
notes: active page 0 + dissolve of page 1 onto the screen (0c1c:08c5)

name: ega_pal_black
notes: clears DS:E788[32]; non-VGA: EGA palette from it (all black)

name: ega_pal_restore
notes: non-VGA: EGA palette from DS:0E6A

name: pal_apply
notes: VGA: upload the DS:0B6A palette buffer (0c1c:0c2a)

name: pal_black
notes: VGA: all 256 colours black (0c1c:0c16)

name: pal_fade_in
notes: VGA: fade in over 16 steps (0c1c:0be5)

name: pal_fade_out
notes: VGA: fade out over 16 steps (0c1c:0b5b)

name: pal_fade_out_low
notes: VGA: fade out colours 0-127 only (0c1c:0bb7)

name: page_keep_high
notes: VGA: on the active page every pixel < 80h becomes 0 (0c1c:0b89)

name: ega_pal_init
notes: Tandy (mode 9): remap DS:0E6A to 4-bit values; EGA/Tandy: set the palette registers

name: copy_protection_check
notes: returns 0 = passed; the check is patched out with NOPs in this copy, dead code follows (01f4:1ed7-01f4:262a)

name: protection_picture_draw
notes: dead code (protection): copies a 64x24 cell n of page 1 (x 80h+64*(n/6)) to page 0

name: playdisk_prompt
notes: message 13h (drive letter), 10h (insert disk) until playdisk_load succeeds, then playdisk_screen

name: race_status_screen
notes: after a leg with several players or computer cars: RACE STATUS page, each car's leg and cumulative records, winner / tie / lost message

name: results_frame_draw
notes: page 1: black bottom, grey panel 4Bh-BDh with frame lines, DETAIL1/2.LZ (units), boxes; 1 = race status layout, 0 = scorecard layout

name: opponent_results
notes: computer cars 1 and 2 (records DS:E80F / DS:E82A): average speed, leg score and cumulative time/distance/average/score, same arithmetic as main

name: pic_draw
type: far void(u8 *pairs int npairs int width int x int ybottom int flag)
notes: VGA: rle_draw_page 0c1c:0c45 (flag unused); else rle_draw_dither 0c1c:1b8a (name from hud.md)

name: race_run
notes: one leg for one player: stage load, cockpit build, frame loop (frame_update, race_input 0, frame_draw, race_input 1, HUD, blit, race_input 2, surface events), >= 5 ticks per frame; returns when DS:008A = 3

name: race_input
notes: phase 0/1: joystick keys (phase 1 only when the last frame took >= 29h ticks) + key_dispatch; phase 2: key_poll + 0e12:0084; then wheel auto-centring and 0792:1310

name: chase_view_exit
notes: back to the cockpit view: music, top bar and cockpit from page 1, compass strip, HUD caches = FFh (name from hud.md)

name: chase_view_enter
notes: music off, save top bar rows 0-15 to page 1, blank them, replay_panel_draw, DS:CC92 = 1 (name from hud.md)

name: replay_panel_draw
notes: CHASE.LZ panel rows 70h-C7h, CHASE CAR VIEW / INSTANT REPLAY + button and viewpoint labels; message 17h when a replay starts (name from hud.md)

name: car_leg_reset
notes: start or restart of a leg: clear replay buffer, physics state, wheel 16, heading and 32-bit position from the start object, eye height; music

name: cockpit_setup
notes: (hud) palettes OTWCOL + <car>COL, cockpit pictures, .ETC and knob masks, backings, L/R.BOT, first frame

name: view_first_frame
notes: frame_update, frame_draw, view_present unless chase view, page 0 (name from hud.md)

name: stage_load_objects
notes: leg start: 3D window geometry, reset clocks/odometer, race_state 1; loads <scene>1.DAT sprites, leg map, T/O/P.BIN, car .POB, opponents' names and .POB; leg_state_reset; fade out (alias stage_load)

name: leg_map_load
notes: loads <scene><'A'+leg>.DAT to DS:9592; no computer cars -> DS:A47B = 2Fh, DS:A47D = 22AFh; colour-pair fix-ups

name: hud_reset_topbar
notes: DS:B709 = FFh; DS:BD34 = FFFFh unless race_state 2; page 0 (name from hud.md)

name: water_overlay_start
notes: (hud) WATER.LZ on page 1, sound 6, first water_roll_step; called by race_run on a crash into water

name: water_roll_step
notes: (hud) one step of the rolling water picture; half-window variant waits 1 BIOS tick

name: broken_glass_overlay
notes: (hud) sound 2, BROKE.LZ over the 3D buffer (colour 0Fh transparent), view_present

name: cockpit_pictures_draw
notes: (hud) 2.BOT, 1.BOT (+ .TOP and page copy when C7h), COMPASS strip

name: leg_score
notes: score of the leg just driven (main state 5), kept while the results pages run

name: shared_loaded
notes: 1 = SELECT/DIFFLEV/SSBJ pictures, SCENETT* sets and NEWWAVE.MUS are in memory; cleared when a stage loads T.BIN over them

name: game_state
notes: main state machine (word, not u8 as in symbols.csv): FFh config, 1 title, 2 protection, 3 top scores, 4 menus, 5 race, 6 results

name: protection_ok
notes: 1 = check passed: 5 lives, results, all legs; 0: 1 life, 2-minute limit, back to the menus after the first leg

name: race_state
notes: 1 driving, 2 restart after a crash (clock restarts), 3 leave the leg

name: key_hit
notes: set by key_poll on any key; aborts the title/credits sequence

name: demo_input
notes: never written: key_poll would call the empty 0977:13da instead of reading keys

name: cfg_0090
notes: cleared by config_load; no reader

name: joystick_on
notes: Ctrl-J sets (and calibrates), Ctrl-K clears

name: joystick_analog
notes: Ctrl-A 1, Ctrl-D 0

name: auto_shift
notes: 1 when skill_level < 3 (set at race start)

name: midi_flag
notes: TD3.CFG word 2

name: active_page
notes: graphics library active page (0 = screen page / 1 = back page); index into DS:90CC

name: kbd_installed
notes: set by kbd_install 0c1c:0e2d

name: playdisk_ok
notes: 1 after a successful playdisk_load

name: dissolve_skippable
notes: only ever cleared: the dissolve never polls keys

name: joy_cal_col
notes: message 5 (joystick calibration) marker x positions

name: joy_cal_row
notes: message 5 marker y positions

name: joy_dir_keys
notes: direction bits -> key code: 0,92h,98h,0,94h,91h,97h,0,96h,93h,91h,0...

name: joy_x_min
notes: joystick calibration (also 00BE centre and 00C0 max)

name: joy_x
notes: last joystick x (00C4 previous)

name: joy_y_min
notes: (also 00C8 centre and 00CA max)

name: joy_y
notes: last joystick y (00CE previous)

name: rand_seed
notes: random() state; 0 at start

name: archive_path
notes: 'A:dataX.dat': drive and archive letter patched by archive_open

name: video_mode_table
notes: library modes for the TD3.CFG choice: 13h VGA, 0Dh EGA, 09h Tandy

name: video_default_choice
notes: default config choice per adapter code of 16cf:0006

name: menu_preview
notes: 1 while the main menu shows the 3D car: stage loaders skip the leg files, the clock does not run

name: cur_player
notes: 1-based player whose record is in DS:09C6

name: leg_dist_units
notes: distance of the leg (miles; km converted x5/8)

name: leg_dist_sixtieths
notes: 1/60 units

name: race_dist_units
notes: cumulative distance

name: lives
notes: 5 (protected) or 1 at race start; -1 per crash (0e12:044e), +2 per completed leg

name: crash_count
notes: cleared before each race_run, +1 in 0e12:044e

name: leg_0a76
notes: cleared before each race_run

name: path_playdisk
notes: 'A:FOOFOOFO.FOO' name buffer on the PLAY DISK drive (palettes, DATAC)

name: path_program
notes: 'A:FOOFOOFO.FOO' name buffer on the program disk drive

name: path_playdisk_dat
notes: 'A:PLAYDISK.DAT'

name: path_car
notes: 'A:CCERV.LST', extension rewritten for car files

name: path_opponent
notes: 'A:CCERV.LST' for the computer cars

name: path_scene
notes: 'A:SCENETT.LST', patched to <scene><x>.<ext>

name: pal_buf
notes: palette buffer 256 x 6-bit RGB (loaded by pal_load, faded/uploaded by platform)

name: playdisk_drive
notes: drive letter inside message 13h

name: msg_insert_label
notes: play disk label inside message 14h

name: msg_table
notes: near pointers to the message records

name: options_skill_text
notes: 'n (auto-shift)' + AAh

name: options_opponent_text
notes: Clock / n Other People / Computer Cars + AAh

name: opp1_name
notes: first computer car name (0792:0d2e)

name: opp2_name
notes: second computer car name

name: results_name_buf
notes: leg name copied for race_status_screen

name: protection_sheet
notes: scene .LST 208h code sheet (dead code only)

name: tjl_flag
notes: 1 when the top-score name is 'TJL' (Tom Loughry): greeting only, no other reader

name: keys_held
notes: held-key bits from the keyboard ISR: 1 up, 2 down, 4 left, 8 right (numeric pad diagonals set two), 10h Enter, 20h space

name: pending_msg
notes: message id shown by race_run at the start of the next frame

name: keep_prev_state
notes: race_run: do not copy race_state to DS:E774 this frame

name: external_view
notes: 0 cockpit, 1 chase car / replay view (also the menu preview)

name: sim_frozen
notes: cleared by race_run; frame_update skips the simulation when set

name: last_key
notes: key code from the keyboard ISR (0 = none)

name: joy_dir
notes: joystick direction bits (8 R 4 L 2 D 1 U) + 10h button

name: page_seg
notes: segments of the two 320x200 RAM pages

name: view_rows_param
notes: 10h in a race, 16h in the menu preview (render3d)

name: text_transparent
notes: 1 = glyph background not drawn

name: text_bg
notes: background colour << 8

name: text_fg
notes: foreground colour << 8

name: text_x
notes: pixel x of the next character

name: text_y
notes: pixel y of the next character row

name: pal_offset
notes: 0 or 80h: added to picture colours and to the palette slot (second colour set 128-255)

name: radio_station
notes: music choice 0-2 ('Change radio station'), argument of music_for_state

name: clock_running
notes: set when a restart releases the car (race_run) and by the gear keys

name: clock_frac
notes: race clock fraction 0-3 (5 frames per clock second, 0e12:0b1d)

name: clock_sec
notes: race clock seconds

name: clock_min
notes: race clock minutes (stops at 59)

name: frame_ticks
notes: timer ticks the previous frame took (race_run)

name: crashed
notes: set by 0e12:0f31

name: frame_count
notes: +1 per frame_update (menu blink parity)

name: crash_water
notes: crash was into water

name: prev_surface
notes: surface type under the car last frame

name: look_rect_dirty
notes: race_run restores a 38h x 30h rectangle from page 1 when set

name: opp1_slot
notes: PLAYDISK car slot of computer car 1

name: opp2_slot
notes: PLAYDISK car slot of computer car 2

name: video_mode
notes: library mode in use: 13h VGA, 0Dh EGA, 09h Tandy

name: weather_dir
notes: direction of the next weather step on surfaces 1Ch-1Eh

name: msg_answer
notes: message_box result: 1 = Y for 26h, digit for 32h

name: car_reset_pending
notes: race_run calls car_leg_reset on the next state change

name: file_handle
notes: shared stdio handle

name: menu_choice
notes: main menu item 0 race, 1 options, 2 car, 3 course, 4 play disk; +80h = chosen

name: cfg_tmp
notes: config choice / scratch

name: adapter_type
notes: from 16cf:0006 (13h VGA)

name: scratch_buf
notes: getcwd buffer (drive letter), PLAYDISK label compare, title light masks

name: player_recs
notes: per player: leg record 8 + dist 2, cumulative record 8 + dist 2, u32 score, lives, 2 spare

name: orig_video_mode
notes: BIOS mode at startup (restored on exit)

name: archive_size
notes: size of the entry found by archive_open

name: name_buf
notes: top-score name entry (15 chars + 80h) / print_score digits

name: score_text
notes: print_score output

name: face_buf
notes: 57B0h bytes; +3E80h -> DS:CEB8, +4B00h -> DS:CC8E, +5780h -> DS:E5B0 (far pointers, not arrays)

name: lz_buf
notes: 7810h bytes: compressed file buffer (and 3D frame segment DS:90D0)

name: water_pic
notes: WATER.LZ / WATEREGA.LZ (12D4h VGA)

name: broke_pic
notes: BROKE.LZ / BROKEGA.LZ (1D06h VGA)

name: chase_pic
notes: CHASE.LZ (37Ah)

name: compass_pic
notes: COMPASS.LZ (113h)

name: diffleva_pic
notes: DIFFLEVA.LZ (inside the DS:E770 block)

name: difflevb_pic
notes: DIFFLEVB.LZ (DS:E770 block + 3520h)

name: difflevc_pic
notes: DIFFLEVC.LZ (DS:E770 block + 6978h)

name: select_pic
notes: SELECT.LZ (DS:E770 block + B34Ch)

name: ssbj_pic
notes: SSBJ.LZ (DS:E770 block + EF74h)

name: car_pob
notes: <car>.POB (8E8h)

name: dos_block
notes: 300h paragraphs from INT 21h/48h (segment also in DS:16B8)
